notes.title: The Revolution Enters Beta!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that RoboSquad has officially moved to Beta! Before we get into all of the changes, here's a message from us:

[b]Welcome to the beginning of a [u]Grand Revolution[/u][/b]

Your decision to join us in the Early Access Alpha of our game is not just a choice to play; it's a choice to shape the future.

This early access phase is a unique opportunity for us to develop, innovate, and expand together. Expect to see incredible battles, strategic masteries, advanced technology and, of course, some unexpected glitches.

Yes, you'll encounter bugs, and we're counting on you to help us find and squash them. Your feedback is not just valued - it's vital. [url=http://robosquadrevolution.com/]Visit our Website[/url] for all the ways you can engage with us to help us enhance the experience.

Without you, this Revolution wouldn't be possible.

We are dedicated to building an exciting world that evolves and prospers, with your assistance. Thank you for your faith, your enthusiasm, and your support. Welcome to the uprising! Together, we shall rewrite history.

Now, onto the changelist:

[b]New System Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Continuing to improve the Gamepad experience
[*] New opening cinematic and tutorial
[*] End of Match flow has been revamped. The winning team screen now features your Zoran taunting!
[/list]
[b]New Gameplay Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Explosive barrels! There's also a special goo variant for Sanctions Labs
[/list]
[b]New Visual Features[/b]
[list]
[*] The enemy and ally Fresnel has been replaced with an outline
[*] You can now preview all throwdowns and abilities in the main menu
[*] You can now preview all weapons in the main menu
[/list]
[b]Maps[/b]
[list]
[*] Continued progress on Sanctions Labs
[/list]
[b]UI / UX[/b]
[list]
[*] The Inventory UI has been updated to reflect our new style!
[*] Murder train notification has been resized
[*] Killfeed size has been reduced
[*] New icons are present for all throwdowns and abilities
[/list]
[b]New Audio Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Ammo pickups now trigger a sound when you interact with them.
[/list]
[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Nyx's rocket boots Kinetic Charge drain and thrust has increased
[*] Nyx's threshold to be able trigger rocket boots has been significantly reduced
[*] Skrill's charge now consumes Kinetic Charge
[*] Piko's double dash now has a shorter cooldown
[*] Time to capture a Control Point has increased
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Samurai hat being see through on one side fixed
[*] Attachments now properly transition in and out for Holograms
[*] Gun Game winner XP now awarded properly
[*] Zoran turn table on titlescreen now
[*] Burst Rifle iconography now consistent across the experience
[*] Fixed audio settings being defaulted to 0
[*] Fixed controller sensitivities being defaulted to 0
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Some attachments aren't positioned correctly on certain classes
[*] Hovering over weapon pickups in close proximity won't update the weapon name
[*] End of Match Zoran positioning can be... erratic
[*] Rarely HUD throwdown icon pointers can get stuck on screen
[/list]

notes.title: Public Alpha Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to New Midian, Zorans.[/h1]

We have officially launched the [b]Public Alpha[/b] of [b]Zorans: Resistance[/b]! From here on out we will be dedicated to crushing bugs and implementing new features. We have a ton of exciting things planned, so be sure to join our Discord!

Over the course of the upcoming weeks we will continue to keep you informed with what we're doing here at Zollpa. Every other Tuesday @ 3pm EST (Starting 6/27) we'll be live streaming our development progress (Sprints) on Twitch and Discord so the community can see what we're working on. Afterwards we'll have a playtest with [b]you[/b] so we can see how you feel about the state of the game!

 [h2]Why Join the Zorans: Resistance Discord?[/h2]
⚙ Stay Connected: Get instant updates on the latest news, patch notes, and upcoming events straight from the development team. Be the first to know about exciting content drops and community challenges.
⚙ Engage with Developers: Interact directly with us! Ask questions and gain valuable insights into the game's design and development process.
⚙ Find Allies: Build your own squad of Zorans! Team up for multiplayer matches, and immerse yourself in a supportive and thriving gaming community.
⚙ Exclusive Sneak Peeks: Gain access to behind-the-scenes content, early previews, and exclusive sneak peeks of upcoming features and updates. Witness the evolution of Zorans firsthand and be a part of shaping its future.
⚙ Participate in Events and Giveaways: Take part in exciting community events for a chance to win exclusive in-game rewards!
⚙ Community Voice: Game with us or just hang out and chat.
⚙ Direct Feedback and Suggestions: Share your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports directly with the development team. Your input will play a vital role in shaping the future updates and ensuring the best possible gaming experience for everyone.

[h3]🔗 Join the Fun![/h3]
To join the official Zoran's Discord server, simply click on the following invitation link: https://discord.gg/bWxMrsjX . If you don't have Discord yet, it's easy to create an account and start connecting with the community.

🎉 Spread the Word and Bring Your Friends! 🎉
Help us create an incredible community by spreading the word about the server!

🙌 Thank You for Your Support! 🙌
Thank you for trying out the game during this Early Access period and helping us grow. We cannot begin to express how important the community is to our developmental process as we add additional content and further expand the world of Zorans.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix Patch - A.0.0.71
notes.content:
- Nameplates and outlines for players should now display properly on first spawn.
- Player / Bot join messages should now have team colors if assigned on non-host clients.
- Slightly increased the accuracy on pistol / reduced spread from movement.
- Halved time between shots for Burst Rifle.
- Tab Scoreboard in game should now update properly for non-host clients.
- Grenade (Q) has slightly less bounce and a bit more gravity.
- Explosions (Grenades / Rockets) were not registering all hits properly, this is now fixed!
